title: microterangis coursiana
intro: Microterangis coursiana, commonly known as the Madagascar orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and improved cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Microterangis coursiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
